name: Wildfire – boreal Northwest Territories (Yellowknife 2023)

geo.extent: Boreal forest of the Northwest Territories and northern prairie provinces

description: In 2023 about 20,000 Yellowknife residents were evacuated and roughly 303 NWT fires burned 4.2 million ha by mid-October. Single-highway access makes evacuation of northern towns difficult.

exposed_areas: Hay River and Fort Smith (South Slave)
documented_events: 2023: Yellowknife evacuated (~20,000 residents); ~303 fires, 4.2 million ha in the NWT (ECCC 2023)
practical_implications: Long summer days and dry conditions; evacuation by one highway or by air

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: Single-season documentation. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
